However, q-11373 contains an authored intermediate arithmetic error: B=-12/6 is false; the preceding equation gives B=2. Its subsequent decomposition and final answer are correct. Independently: q-114999 integration by parts gives 10I=(ln x)^10/4, hence the definite integral is 1/40. For q-49609 and q-15421, differentiating the selected antiderivatives gives e^(2x)cos x and e^(6x)sin x respectively. For q-49967, evaluating e^(3x)(sin x+3cos x)/10 at 0 and 2π gives 3(e^(6π)-1)/10. For q-71128, the altitude is |MD×MA|/|MA|=4√6/(2√3)=2√2. For q-103991, the partial-fraction coefficients are 1 and -1, whose sum is 0. For q-103989, the integrand is 1/x+1/(x-4). For q-68215, the limit is (1/3)(1-1)=0. For q-73546, the expression is (tan θ/θ)^2, tending to 1. For q-49902, the antiderivative is 4ln|x-2|-8/(x-2), giving 4ln 2+4. For q-11373, the partial fractions have coefficients 1, 2, and 3, yielding the selected antiderivative despite the source typo. For q-3612, the decomposition is 6/t-1/(t+1)+9/(t+1)^2. For q-115662 and q-82892, the decompositions are (x+8)^(-2)-10(x+8)^(-3) and 3(x+1)^(-2)-2(x+1)^(-3). For q-7113, displacement is [2t^2+t^3] from 1 to 4, or 93, so position is 105. For q-81515, the supplied graph gives signed areas 2+1/2-5/2=0 between times 1 and 7, so position remains 2. No earlier submitted answer or grade was supplied; confirmation of the final values rests on each question's own captured worked solution.",
